model-data.json.basis: All modeled column, porch-pan, channel, stair and landing concrete. Above/below-grade display zones count once as continuous columns. Round columns use πd²L/4; square columns use width × depth × length. Pan/stair quantities integrate the actual sloped occupied meshes and exclude drain/outlet voids. Adjacent mesh pieces partition the pour; they are not separate forms.
model-data.json.exclusions: Enlarged footings or bell bases, grade beams, over-excavation, reinforcement and concrete mix details remain unspecified and are excluded. Pan, stair and support reinforcement/capacity require design.
model-data.json.designStatus: Geometry takeoff, not foundation sizing. Verify soils, frost depth, bearing, reinforcement, concrete strength, anchors and bracing before ordering.
